Opening, second-interpretation lead/Collect/Communion, first-interpretation Epistle and chants sentences, and third-interpretation lead and 'Epistle's answer' rewritten; Jerome credited only with joining Jer 29:13 to Mt 7:7.

No 'On this interpretation', 'Read with', 'Taken so/together', 'Set beside', 'taken with', 'in the parable's terms' or 'is read here' remains; surviving inferences are marked once in varied words with their reason.

Cited closers deleted or reduced per the review's rewrites; the first interpretation's ground stated once in the interpretation and once in the comparison; the plain restatement of Augustine's grounds and the Chrysostom/Jerome summary also cut.

New anagogical item from Chrysostom's 'He that endureth to the end' (now quoted at the sleepers), Aquinas's canticles referred ad promissa aeterna (now quoted in the singing subsection, Dessain OCR read) and Mt 13:30; no Sermo 73 or Rabanus.

ST II-II q.10 a.8 ad 1 and q.11 a.3/ad 3 re-read in the bound English Dominican text and reported as given, Contra ep. Parmeniani only as Aquinas cites it; the comparison names all four positions, Jerome's in the body's terms, with no grading.
Now: with the Alleluia before the Gospel, the words are heard three times before the Secret.
